s1.syndrome_frame: Subacute onset of painful lower-extremity swelling and erythema with systemic symptoms
salient_findings: Painful left lower-extremity swelling and erythema
Intermittent fevers, episodic night sweats, decreased appetite, and palpitations
Ill-defined, warm, confluent erythema, edema, and tender induration on the left calf
key_facts: 53-year-old Hispanic man
Incidentally noted bilateral adrenal and periaortic retroperitoneal masses six months earlier
Denies trauma or injury to the leg
Mild lymphocytopenia, moderate anemia, elevated creatine kinase, elevated aldolase, and elevated lactate dehydrogenase
Peripheral-blood flow cytometry was unremarkable
CT and MRI of the leg revealed gastrocnemius myositis, extensive subcutaneous and superficial myofascial edema, and popliteal lymphadenopathy
No improvement with intravenous ceftriaxone for presumed cellulitis and pyomyositis
Punch biopsy of skin from the lower leg showed a sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells

shortlist.label: Extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma nasal type
shortlist.why_kept: Atypical mononuclear cells on biopsy and lack of response to antibiotics

shortlist.label: Pyomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Imaging findings of myositis and initial clinical presentation

shortlist.label: Dermatomyositis
shortlist.why_kept: Skin and muscle involvement with elevated muscle enzymes

shortlist.label: Lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Retroperitoneal masses and cytopenias, although peripheral blood flow cytometry was unremarkable

s4.champion: Extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma nasal type

raw.champion: Extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma nasal type
raw.rationale: The presence of a sparse perivascular and interstitial infiltrate of enlarged atypical mononuclear cells in the punch biopsy, along with systemic symptoms such as fevers, night sweats, and weight loss, and the lack of response to antibiotics, points towards a lymphoma, specifically Extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma nasal type, given the involvement of the skin and soft tissues.

rejected.label: Pyomyositis
rejected.why: No improvement with antibiotics and biopsy results not consistent with pyomyositis

rejected.label: Dermatomyositis
rejected.why: Biopsy results showed atypical mononuclear cells, not characteristic of dermatomyositis

rejected.label: Granulomatosis with polyangiitis
rejected.why: No evidence of granulomatous inflammation or vasculitis in the biopsy results

rejected.label: Lymphoma
rejected.why: Too broad, Extranodal natural killer/T-cell lymphoma nasal type is a more specific diagnosis that fits the clinical presentation and biopsy results
